caption: The drawing features a central figure riding in a two-wheeled chariot that is being pulled by a pair of winged griffins. The figure, who is draped in flowing garments, is holding the reins in both hands and appears to be in motion. The griffins, facing to the right, have the bodies of lions and the heads and wings of eagles. The chariot has a decorative wheel with a detailed design. In the background, there are two trees with dark brown trunks and branches, with red and yellow foliage, positioned on the left and right sides of the composition. The ground below holds some smaller plants and a large ornate vase or urn near the front paws of the rightmost griffin. The entire scene is set against a bright blue background, and the objects in the drawing are mainly outlined and highlighted in shades of brown, beige, red, and blue, giving the image a textured appearance. The artwork is placed on a cream-colored paper with a rectangular blue section forming the scene in the center.
title: Bandbox (section)
